description: This PHP source file defines a class smpl_Invoice_Sample that generates an invoice PDF template with methods for retrieving the invoice type, body content, header, and footer. It references external services and translation functions to build the invoice layout.

classes.name: smpl_Invoice_Sample
classes.description: A class that provides methods to generate invoice PDF content, including header, footer, and body layout with dynamic data placeholders.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of document, which is 'AOS_Invoices'.

methods.name: getBody
methods.description: Generates the HTML content for the invoice body, including company logo, billing information, invoice details, and itemized list.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Returns an empty string for the header content.

methods.name: getFooter
methods.description: Generates the HTML footer with page number and date, using locale preferences.
